text:
Type: shaggy high-pile area rug
Use: adding softness and warmth underfoot, under a sofa, bed or coffee table; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: thick shag pile yarn in mixed tones
Colors: light grey, off-white, heathered, cool
Shape: rectangular, plush medium-long shag, heathered solid tone, soft edges, large and cushiony
Feel: cozy, soft, calm, light
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, grey sofas, chrome accents; Scandinavian, minimalist or contemporary rooms

product.name: ALHEDE
product.description: The dense, thick pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
